question: Does full-precision endpoint/domain timing improve on CPD plateaus, and can strict and secondary policies run automatically from identical states without tolerance drift?
user_steering: Continue currentSTA repair, no another long strategy report. Automatic select/query/replace/FULL-STA/accept-or-rollback; refresh targets after every accepted state; same-selector native repair control with matched scope/tree/opportunity; no overall date/call cap.
observed_constraints: Original runs request eltwise_layer.sdc but it is absent. Native default constraints: virtual_io_clock for primary I/O; clk and clk_mem; optimize as fast as possible; cut cross-netlist-clock paths. Export full applied native constraint object to bind exact domain pairs, IO delays, uncertainties and latencies; do not silently introduce an SDC.
vector: Fixed timing-graph SINK endpoints, identified by atom pin and timing-node identity, with setup slack for every constrained launch/capture domain pair. Preserve unconstrained/nonfinite statuses explicitly. Store all raw hold slack tags; guard nonworsening negative hold-slack violations, not monotonic positive hold margins.
full_precision: Native float values emitted with17digits; CPD from least_slack_critical_path().delay() matching native report definition, plus longest critical path and per-domain critical path information. Exact <=/>= comparisons of exported native numbers; no positive epsilon acceptance or cumulative tolerance.

policies.strict: Legal/nativeFULL, fixed input endpoint/constraint identity, no increased hold violation, full-precision CPD strictly lower.
policies.secondary: Same validity checks; full-precision CPD nonincreasing and every setup endpoint/domain slack nondecreasing with at least one strictly larger. Separate branch from same original; after divergence target selection uses each branch currentSTA. Raw connection-delay monotonicity is not this criterion.

implementation: Extend existing defaultoff readonly finalanalysis exporter with all timing endpoints and native exact metrics/constraints. Preserve frozen stage03. Analysis-only validation on original R1 and its already completed strict-rejected plateau candidate, plus original A0 and current coordinated A0 tie. Reuse route search results; no new route search to inspect endpoints.
followup: Implement generic automatic state machine with canonical route/input/analyzer/constraint hashes, duplicate candidate cache, perbranch accepted-state journals, postacceptance STA target refresh and all-attempt costs. Native same-selector same-scope repair remains a distinct required comparison; do not call graphDijkstra native VPR repair.
